intro.title: Build a tooltip with smart positioning
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a tooltip component that automatically positions itself around a target element, like a button, to avoid being cut off by the edge of the screen. You'll learn how to use the JavaScript DOM API to calculate the available viewport space and adjust the tooltip's placement dynamically. The core programming concept involves conditionally checking the position of elements and applying different CSS classes based on those calculations. You'll work with event listeners, element measurements, and CSS styling to create a smart, reusable UI feature.
intro.usecase: Smart tooltip positioning is essential in modern web applications where space is limited and user experience is critical. In data dashboards and analytics tools, tooltips dynamically reposition to avoid overlapping with charts, graphs, or other UI elements when displaying detailed metrics. Form builders and design tools use this pattern to show field descriptions or validation hints that adjust based on available screen space. E-commerce platforms implement smart tooltips for product information popups that avoid covering important buttons or images, ensuring smooth shopping experiences.
